description: This file contains instrumentation functions for various web frameworks, HTTP libraries, and databases using OpenTelemetry. It defines methods to instrument FastAPI, Flask, requests, httpx, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, Redis, and placeholders for DB API and OpenAI integrations, primarily for tracing and monitoring purposes.

classes.name: InstrumentedClient
classes.description: Custom subclass of httpx.Client that wraps the send method with instrumentation for tracing HTTP requests.

classes.name: InstrumentedAsyncClient
classes.description: Custom subclass of httpx.AsyncClient that wraps the async send method with instrumentation for tracing HTTP requests.

methods.name: _decode_body
methods.description: Decodes a body object to UTF-8 string if it is bytes, otherwise returns it as is.

methods.name: _instrument_fastapi
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry instrumentation for FastAPI, including request and response hooks.

methods.name: _instrument_requests
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry instrumentation for requests library with request and response hooks.

methods.name: _instrument_httpx
methods.description: Instruments httpx client and async client to add tracing spans around HTTP requests.

methods.name: _instrument_flask
methods.description: Instruments Flask app to add tracing spans for incoming HTTP requests.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlalchemy
methods.description: Instruments SQLAlchemy to trace database queries, including capturing query results for SELECT statements.

methods.name: _instrument_dbapi
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting generic DB API; currently not implemented.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlite3
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting sqlite3; currently not implemented.

methods.name: _instrument_redis
methods.description: Instruments Redis client to trace Redis commands and responses.

methods.name: _instrument_openai
methods.description: Placeholder for OpenAI API instrumentation; currently not implemented.

methods.name: apply_instrumentation
methods.description: Main function to apply all available instrumentations for web frameworks, HTTP libraries, and databases.
